rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the end of a shirt sleeve.

example.english: The cuff of this shirt has come loose.
example.traditional: 呢件恤衫嘅袖口甩咗線。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 seot1 saam1 ge3 zau6 hau2 lat1 zo2 sin3

rows.note: Use this for a metal restraint put around a person's wrist.

example.english: The police took a cuff off his wrist.
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 bong1 keoi5 ceoi4 dai1 sau2 kaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the folded-up end of a trouser leg, rather than the general trouser leg or hem.

example.english: I like to fold up the cuff of my trousers because it makes walking easier.
example.traditional: 我鍾意反摺褲腳，行路方便啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 faan2 zip3 fu3 goek3 haang4 lou6 fong1 bin6 di1
